title: Prepare wavefunk-ui components for AllowThem template migration
description: Epic for closing the component/API gaps identified in docs/wavefunk-ui-template-migration-readiness.md. Treat /home/nambiar/projects/wavefunk/ui version 0.1.2 at 769a7ba as canonical until the local crate is published.

title: Add auth shell primitives to wavefunk-ui
description: Add typed Askama AuthShell/AuthFormPanel equivalents plus AuthKicker, AuthTabs, OAuthProviderGrid, and TermsFooter so AllowThem login/register/password/MFA/consent pages can move off MiniJinja macros. Use local wavefunk-ui checkout as canonical.

title: Decide and implement branded splash support
description: Decide whether shader/iframe branded splash belongs in wavefunk-ui or remains AllowThem-specific. If shared, add typed AuthSplash/ShaderAsciiSplash and asset/runtime support for the current canvas[data-shader-ascii] behavior.

title: Add modeline and mode-toggle components
description: Add typed Modeline and ModelineSegment support to wavefunk-ui, including optional logout/action segments, [data-mode-toggle] support, and parity with AllowThem's minibuffer history where needed.

title: Extend app shell for AllowThem chrome
description: Extend or wrap wavefunk-ui AppShell for AllowThem's mode-locked html attrs, anchor brand, pageheader slots, has-header/has-tablewrap main modifiers, and modeline+minibuffer footer layout.

title: Add tenant workspace navigation components
description: Add WorkspaceSwitcher plus Sidenav/SidenavSection/SidenavItem components for tenant dashboard navigation, including muted and coming-soon states and a role-to-badge/tag mapping.

title: Map legacy form aliases to typed components
description: Migrate or alias legacy AllowThem form classes such as wf-formfield, wf-form-row, wf-help, wf-hint, wf-flash, wf-flash-warn, wf-btn-primary, and wf-link/link-quiet. Prefer existing wavefunk-ui typed components unless exact HTML compatibility is required.

title: Add auth security display components
description: Cover AllowThem-specific security displays: password-strength meter, OAuth consent scope list, credential/secret copy or reveal panel, and MFA recovery-code list/grid. Decide which stay in AllowThem domain code versus reusable wavefunk-ui components.

title: Replace legacy list pager and table chrome
description: Map AllowThem's wf-pager*, wf-filter-form, wf-tablefoot, wf-tag-remove, and row action markup to existing DataTable, FilterBar, Pagination, TableFooter, BulkActionBar, and RowSelect APIs, adding wavefunk-ui gaps only if needed.
